_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ui_language" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "daily_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "behavior" TEXT NOT NULL, "show_first_word" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("show_first_word" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "unit" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_word_index" INTEGER NULL, "to_word_index" INTEGER NULL, "skill_id" TEXT NULL, "surah" INTEGER NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_unit_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "unit_state" ("unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "queue" TEXT NOT NULL, "memory_state" TEXT NULL, "fsrs_card" TEXT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "recent_since" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_method" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("unit_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attempt" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "hints" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_event_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "words" INTEGER NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "rules_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_event" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_indexes" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "heard_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "jump_from_word_index" INTEGER NULL, "jump_to_word_index" INTEGER NULL, "audio_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "audio_end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "versions" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_word_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_word_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "behavior" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "listening_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "signal_ok_ratio" REAL NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_plan" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "items" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lesson_progress" ("lesson_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "step_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quiz_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lesson_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setting" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download" ("package_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_version" TEXT NULL, "pending_version" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bytes_done" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("package_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_key_cache" ("normalizer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("normalizer_id", "word_index"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ngram_cache" ("normalizer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ngram" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_indexes" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("normalizer_id", "ngram"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_recording" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "upload_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "meta" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "tries" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entitlement_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_verified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "free_usage" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "listening_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX unit_profile_kind ON unit (profile_id, kind)
CREATE INDEX unit_state_due_at ON unit_state (due_at)
CREATE INDEX attempt_unit_created ON attempt (unit_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX check_event_session ON check_event (session_id)
CREATE INDEX upload_queue_state_priority ON upload_queue (state, priority)
